author: skippio46
quote: This game is terrible! Not sure what the so called professional game critics have been smoking. But the characters are so uncharismatic. The many tedious side quests  that having nothing to do with the main theme of the game. The leading female character spends her entire time complaining about stuff and you feel completely cucked out. The game also plays really badly on PS5 OG version. The FPS is so low for a game brought out in 2026. Regret buying this game it was a waste of time and money!
